reply.subject: Rent increase: deadline and documents needed

clauses.text: We have recorded that you received a rent-increase notice on 28 October and that it gives the rise in the mortgage reference interest rate as the reason for the increase.

The information currently available does not establish the applicable challenge deadline. Please confirm the year in which you received the notice and send the delivery evidence showing the exact date it was delivered, so that the deadline can be checked.

Please send the lease contract, the rent-increase notice, evidence of your current rent and its components, the previous rent adjustment, and the notice's stated reasons and calculation, including the reference-rate basis and relevant dates.

Could you also send any correspondence with the property manager about the increase? If you have already filed a challenge, please send a copy and evidence of timely submission to the conciliation authority.
